title: ze_pretender
description:
>> 6 stage 3 Normal 3 Extra << 

>>When the world has gathered 67 bottles of the legendary diddy's baby oil, the mysterious 67 Man will be summoned, and he will grant you 67 wishes.That's right, this passage has nothing to do with this map.

>> You can try breaking jars, weapon barrels, and boxes - they may drop some coins. Of course, you can also try killing NPCs, who will randomly drop items and coins when defeated. When you have enough coins, you can upgrade your character's HP, Agility, CD, and LUCK, which will affect the game balance. You can also purchase various weapons, each with immense power and the ability to change the tide of battle. If you're not satisfied with normal matches, you can challenge more ZM events. 

>> Thanks for your play <<

>> Disable oldpush <<
>> Disable oldpush <<

>>Please change the zombie spawn time to at least 10s.<<

>>More items might be added in the future
 
 

 >>nor: Humans can choose from four basic weapons and upgrade attributes with turn limits. Max gold storage is 500g. Zombies can choose one weapons. 
 >>ex: Humans have access to a wider variety of random weapons with a reroll option and can upgrade attributes without turn limits. Max gold storage is 999g. Zombies can choose four weapons and select one event from four round events. 

>>> Note: In the event of a draw or a Zombie victory, gold and attribute gains for this round will be reverted. 

 >>HP: Increases max HP for all players (Max: 250).
>>CD: Reduces weapon cooldowns by percentage (Max reduction: 50%).
>>Agility: Reduces all incoming damage by percentage (Max reduction: 30%).
>>Luck: Increases drop rates for coin-based weapons and reduces drop rates for certain zombie events. There is a minimal chance to trigger damage immunity (Max: 40%).
